objective: Ejecutar fisicamente en Development, de forma controlada, la migracion YA CERTIFICADA backend/database/migrations/20260910_cavas_socios_persona_link.sql. No crear otra migracion. El Worker debe crear un canal DEDICATED_MIGRATION_WRITER aislado para este Gate, con preflight y postcheck usando exclusivamente HRLectura y ejecucion DDL exclusivamente con EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER/PASSWORD. El canal debe validar el blob inmutable de la migracion, bloquear Production, prohibir HRLectura como writer, ejecutar solo esa migracion y certificar despues PersonaID bigint NULL, FK exacta a Gobierno_Persona(PersonaID), indice filtrado esperado, las tres FK hijas por SocioID intactas y los socios actuales con PersonaID NULL. No backfill, no ClienteID, no auto-creacion de Persona, no Mongo.

actions.content:
name: Cavas Gate12I Persona Link Development Migration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - Edarsahub_Desarrollo
    paths:
      - ops/migrations/requests/CAVAS-GATE12I-PERSONA-LINK-20260910.execute

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cavas-gate12i-persona-link-development-migration
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate-development:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: '54.39.104.176'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: '1433'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: 'EDARSAHUB'
      MIGRATION_SCRIPT: backend/database/migrations/20260910_cavas_socios_persona_link.sql
      EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA: '12fbb8f75659c3b1103a56bcc60a22fb155c8d98'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact Development commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install SQL runtime
        run: python -m pip install pymssql pydantic python-dotenv email-validator

      - name: Verify Development and immutable migration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
          test -f "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
          actual_blob="$(git hash-object "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}")"
          echo "EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA=${EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA}"
          echo "ACTUAL_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA=${actual_blob}"
          test "${actual_blob}" = "${EXPECTED_MIGRATION_BLOB_SHA}"
          echo 'GATE12I_IMMUTABLE_MIGRATION=PASS'

      - name: Preflight readonly canonical state
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p evidence
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD:-}"
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/preflight.txt
          import os,pymssql
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() db_user")
          ident=q.fetchone(); print({'identity':ident})
          if ident['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or ident['login_name']!='HRLectura' or ident['db_user']!='HRLectura': raise SystemExit('GATE12I_READONLY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
          q.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND name=N'PersonaID'")
          if int(q.fetchone()['n'])!=0: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PERSONAID_ALREADY_EXISTS')
          q.execute("SELECT c.name column_name,t.name data_type,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') AND i.is_primary_key=1 ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal")
          rows=q.fetchall(); print({'persona_pk':rows})
          if rows!=[{'column_name':'PersonaID','data_type':'bigint','key_ordinal':1}]: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PERSONA_PK_MISMATCH')
          q.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona')")
          if int(q.fetchone()['n'])!=0: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PREEXISTING_PERSONA_FK')
          q.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND name=N'IX_CavaSocios_Socios_PersonaID'")
          if int(q.fetchone()['n'])!=0: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PREEXISTING_PERSONA_INDEX')
          q.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') AND pc.name=N'SocioID' AND rc.name=N'SocioID' AND fk.is_disabled=0 AND fk.is_not_trusted=0")
          if int(q.fetchone()['n'])!=3: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_CHILD_FK_BASELINE_MISMATCH')
          q.close(); c.close(); print('GATE12I_PREFLIGHT=PASS')
          PY

      - name: Verify dedicated Development migration writer
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER }}
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER:-}"
          test -n "${EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD:-}"
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/writer_permissions.txt
          import os,pymssql
          if os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'].strip().lower()=='hrlectura': raise SystemExit('GATE12I_HRLECTURA_WRITER_FORBIDDEN')
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.CavaSocios_Socios','OBJECT','ALTER'),0) can_alter_socios,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Gobierno_Persona','OBJECT','REFERENCES'),0) can_reference_persona")
          row=q.fetchone(); print({'database_name':row['database_name'],'can_alter_socios':row['can_alter_socios'],'can_reference_persona':row['can_reference_persona']})
          q.close(); c.close()
          if row['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or int(row['can_alter_socios'])!=1 or int(row['can_reference_persona'])!=1: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_WRITER_PERMISSION_MISSING')
          print('GATE12I_DEDICATED_WRITER=PASS')
          PY

      - name: Execute certified transactional migration
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER }}
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD }}
          EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}" 2>&1 | tee evidence/migration.txt
          echo 'GATE12I_MIGRATION=PASS'

      - name: Postcheck readonly physical certification
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY' | tee evidence/postcheck.txt
          import os,pymssql
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() db_user")
          ident=q.fetchone(); print({'identity':ident})
          if ident['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or ident['login_name']!='HRLectura' or ident['db_user']!='HRLectura': raise SystemExit('GATE12I_POSTCHECK_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
          q.execute("SELECT c.name column_name,t.name data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name=N'PersonaID'")
          col=q.fetchone(); print({'personaid':col})
          if not col or col['data_type']!='bigint' or int(col['is_nullable'])!=1: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PERSONAID_METADATA_FAIL')
          q.execute("SELECT fk.name fk_name,pc.name parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) referenced_table,rc.name referenced_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND pc.name=N'PersonaID'")
          fks=q.fetchall(); print({'persona_fks':fks})
          if len(fks)!=1 or fks[0]['fk_name']!='FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona' or fks[0]['referenced_schema']!='dbo' or fks[0]['referenced_table']!='Gobierno_Persona' or fks[0]['referenced_column']!='PersonaID' or fks[0]['is_disabled'] or fks[0]['is_not_trusted']: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PERSONA_FK_FAIL')
          q.execute("SELECT i.name index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_disabled,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,c.name column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND i.name=N'IX_CavaSocios_Socios_PersonaID' ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal")
          idx=q.fetchall(); print({'persona_index':idx})
          if len(idx)!=1 or idx[0]['column_name']!='PersonaID' or int(idx[0]['key_ordinal'])!=1 or idx[0]['is_disabled'] or not idx[0]['has_filter'] or 'PersonaID' not in str(idx[0]['filter_definition']): raise SystemExit('GATE12I_PERSONA_INDEX_FAIL')
          q.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') AND pc.name=N'SocioID' AND rc.name=N'SocioID' AND fk.is_disabled=0 AND fk.is_not_trusted=0")
          if int(q.fetchone()['n'])!=3: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_CHILD_FK_POSTCHECK_FAIL')
          q.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) personaid_null,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) personaid_present FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios")
          pop=q.fetchone(); print({'population':pop})
          if int(pop['personaid_present'] or 0)!=0: raise SystemExit('GATE12I_UNEXPECTED_BACKFILL')
          q.close(); c.close(); print('GATE12I_POSTCHECK=PASS')
          PY

      - name: Upload Gate12I evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cavas-gate12i-persona-link-development-migration-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

constraints: Gate12G remains closed and must not be modified
Gate12H readiness is already certified and must not be rerun
Botellas Cargos Movimientos remain linked by SocioID
HRLectura only for preflight and postcheck
DDL writer must use EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER and EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD
No secrets in repository or output
